title: Standing Ab-Wheel Rollout
summary: An ab-wheel rollout started from standing, a very hard and long lever version of the kneeling rollout.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for abs (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly abs total.
Library rating 0.35 for lats (minor): each working set adds 0.35 of a set to the weekly lats total.
Library rating 0.25 for obliques (minor): each working set adds 0.25 of a set to the weekly obliques total.

setup.text: Stand with the wheel on the floor in front of you, legs straight.
Roll out until your body is nearly parallel with the floor.
Pull back up with your abs.

form_cues.cue: Roll forward as far as you can control
Only for people who own the kneeling version. Roll up a slope to start.

mistakes.text: Rolling past the point you can return from.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train comfortably.
